Optional diagram-wide FSM transition formatting (values in pixels):

transition-spacing: 110
transition-label-width: 300

transition-spacing adds a minimum gap between state ranks, in addition to the
space the automatic layout reserves for labels. Increase it for longer arrows.
The default is 50.4 px. It follows direction: TB or direction: LR.

transition-label-width sets the preferred line width of transition labels.
Increase it for longer text lines and fewer wraps; decrease it for narrower,
taller labels. Without this setting, the existing 32-character wrap is retained.
Both options must be greater than zero and apply to the entire diagram.

You can still place explicit line breaks in an individual label using literal
backslash-n sequences, for example:

Idle -> Evaluation : evSummaryAvailable [isLatestSummary == true]/\nevaluateStallingSumary

Text is preserved. The formatter measures the selected font, wraps as needed,
and reserves space for the resulting labels before routing the transitions.
